title: Merge overlapping closed intervals
prompt: Implement mergeIntervals in src/intervals.js. It receives an array of [start, end] closed intervals and returns a new array sorted by start, with overlapping or touching intervals merged. Do not mutate the input. An empty array returns an empty array. Throw TypeError for a non-array or a malformed interval where start/end are not finite numbers or start > end. Keep the existing named export.
